reviews.author: Bordeaux&castles
reviews.title: Undewhelming experience we won't repeat again
reviews.text:
I have long been a devoted fan of the Fairmont Hotels & Resorts brand, which made this recent stay at the Fairmont Scottsdale Princess particularly disappointing.

At over $800 per night, we were assigned a room in a remote area of the property, with a patio that unfortunately had a cigarette butt upon arrival—an unwelcome first impression. We also learned that the air hockey machine was out of order, and there was no drink service at the pool on our first day.

It quickly became clear that this is a heavily conference-oriented property, with many guests attending corporate events. The scale of the resort contributes to a very different atmosphere than what I have come to expect from Fairmont over the past 30 years. It lacks the sense of service, charm, and overall experience that distinguishes many of the brand’s flagship and more boutique properties.

By comparison, stays at properties such as Fairmont Le Château Frontenac, Fairmont Empress, Fairmont Pacific Rim, Fairmont Miramar Hotel & Bungalows, and Fairmont Orchid have consistently delivered a far more elevated and memorable experience—often at a significantly lower price point.

This property felt disproportionately priced for what was offered and seemed far better suited to corporate groups than to a family vacation. Unfortunately, it did not reflect the level of quality and hospitality I have come to associate with the Fairmont name.

We will certainly continue our loyalty to this beloved brand of ours, just not at Princess Scottsdale.

reviews.author: Leanne A
reviews.title: The most magical family vacation!
reviews.text:
Never has a hotel been more aptly named - we felt like royalty from the moment we walked in to the moment we (very sadly) left. The staff in this hotel are outstanding, the food in each of the venues is fantastic, and the resort is just stunning and magical.

There were so many exceptional staff in the resort it’s hard to know where to start - but Betsy and Brittany in ironwood really looked after us for dinner
Keith from bell was so helpful and has been with the hotel for such a long time - and he’s clearly still so passionate about it that it’s infectious!
Jake at the pool looked after us on a daily basis, remembering details about what we had planned to do the previous day and asking how it had been etc, like he genuinely cared. Marco at Sunset pool was so cool and looked after us so well - and Melissa always remembered our order! 
Dominic was our first server at breakfast on our first day and made us feel so welcome! Sandy was another breakfast server that went above and beyond for us to make sure we had everything we needed. Carlee was also amazing and made sure the kids were heard! 😊

We celebrated a birthday while we were there, and Jeff in  bourbon steak made sure it was the most memorable and special experience!
The plaza bar is a nice place to grab a quick drink before dinner (their bar menu is also nice) and you will always be met with a smile and a really friendly chat by Veronica! 

Honestly one of the best Mexican meals I’ve ever had was in La Hacienda - and the coffee after dinner is a real spectacle to behold and the most delicious coffee you will ever taste - don’t skip it even if coffee keeps you awake, it’s worth it!!! Carlos was fantastic at explaining the menu and Nick who I think was the manager, saw the note of the birthday on our profile and brought the most amazing sharing dessert which was so special!  

I can’t talk highly enough of this stay and we cannot wait to visit again. It was truly the most fantastic family vacation that made memories we will all cherish - mostly down to the people who looked after us. We are so grateful to you all!!!!!

reviews.author: Brandon Bovre
reviews.title: Huge Resort with Great Amenities, Just Needs a Refresh
reviews.text:
Check in was easy and smooth. One thing to note is how big the property is. They actually took me to my room by golf cart because of how far it was, which I appreciated when dealing with luggage.

The resort itself is massive with a ton of space to spread out. It never felt crowded and there is a lot to do on property. The outlets and dining options were really solid.

Ate at La Hacienda, their Mexican restaurant, and it was very good. Definitely one of the highlights of the stay.

Also kind of a random but fun detail, there is actually a tortoise that lives on the property. His name is Cecil and he has been part of the resort for years now. People actually go out of their way to find him, which adds a little personality to the place.

As for the room, it was just ok. Nothing terrible, but nothing that really stood out either. Mine had a bit of an odd layout and felt like it could use an update. Not sure when a renovation is coming, but it feels like it is due. The carpet looked worn and could have used a good cleaning.

It had the basics like an honor bar and a Nespresso machine, which were nice to have, but did not really make up for how dated the room felt overall. You can tell it was probably incredible in its prime and still has that foundation, just needs a little attention in spots now.

Overall, still a good stay. Great property, great amenities, just a few areas that could be tightened up to match the rest of the experience.

reviews.author: Megan B
reviews.title: Amazing conference venue!
reviews.text: Stayed here for a recent conference. Very impressed by the quality of meeting spaces, grounds, and rooms. The food provided through the conference and prepared by the hotel was excellent. Rooms were comfortable with spacious patio to sit and relax.

reviews.author: Joan D
reviews.title: Know before you go
reviews.text: Overall, my stay at the Fairmont Scottsdale Princess for RGC ended up being a good experience, but it did start off very poorly. I paid for an upgraded room and was placed in a room that did not feel upgraded in any way. I was initially told nothing could be done, but after speaking with other attendees paying the same rate and seeing their rooms, I went back to the front desk to address it again. This was especially disappointing because the first two days before my conference were meant to be relaxing time with my daughter and newborn grandbaby, and the accommodations made that difficult. Thankfully, Colin and Jacob at the front desk were excellent. They listened, helped resolve the issue, discounted the stay, and moved me to a much better room. Overall, the staff was very kind and went out of their way to help. The only other area for improvement would be clearer front desk communication about the property, especially how and when the golf carts are used. Once I figured it out, everything worked well. My advice would be to be very specific about the room and the distance. It is from the lobby of the hotel. The photograph when I booked my room online was a far cry from the room I received, and if there was mention of the distance I missed it.

reviews.author: Charles D
reviews.title: Something for everyone
reviews.text:
Something for Everyone.

We had a wonderful two-night stay in one of the private casitas. Everything was fantastic.

First and foremost, the resort is vast, featuring multiple pools, restaurants, and shops. There’s truly something for everyone here. The rooms were immaculately clean and well-appointed.

The only slight disappointment was that we didn’t have enough time to visit the spa.

Overall, it was a fantastic resort, and I would definitely return.

reviews.author: Joseph A
reviews.title: Expectations Exceeded @ Fairmont Princess (Privado Casita)
reviews.text:
My family and I reserved a Privado Casita and arrived to find that location is a separate lobby and entrance to the property. Immediately my wife and I were concerned to be too distant to the entire properties amenities. One of the welcome staff at the Privado lobby, Ryan, took us for a tour of the property i and immediately we knew the level of attention and hospitality was going meet or exceed our expectations. We were greeted even by Chana after our tour as our room was not ready yet and Chana could not have been nicer and Kind. She made us comfortable with their welcome drinks and snacks. She made my kids laugh and my wife and I feel at ease. The entire stay from that moment on was fantastic. The restaurants on property were delicious to include Toro by shuttle. Room service was fantastic and drinks to the room were as if just ordered from a bar. 

Again, big shout out to Ryan and Chana for being responsive and hospitable during our entire stay. Also. Thank you to Sarah Vaughn who created our entire itinerary for
The trip to include golf, kids golf lessons and dinners.

Can't wait to come back!

reviews.author: Cruiser787997
reviews.title: Front desk professionalism
reviews.text: Collin was great, very professional!

reviews.author: Kim K
reviews.title: Impeccable Service Made Our 50th Unforgettable
reviews.text:
Our stay at the Fairmont Scottsdale Princess for my brother’s and my 50th birthday was truly exceptional. We traveled with our spouses and friends, and from the moment we arrived, everything felt thoughtful and elevated.

We stayed in Privado, and the suites were beautiful—spacious, comfortable, and designed to feel like a true home away from home. We were welcomed with birthday balloons from housekeeping and a slice of incredible cake from the hotel, which was such a special touch.

Throughout the entire stay, the service stood out. From breakfast to the pool, to the bars and every dinner, the staff was consistently warm, attentive, and genuinely focused on making the experience memorable.

We had lunch at Toro Latin Restaurant & Rum Bar with stunning golf course views, spent afternoons enjoying great poolside service, and had an incredible dinner at Bourbon Steak Scottsdale. The concierge also recommended a helicopter tour of the red rocks, which ended up being a true highlight of the trip.

We wrapped up our stay with a fantastic meal at La Hacienda at the Fairmont Scottsdale Princess and a relaxing evening by the outdoor fireplaces—such a perfect ending.

An amazing place for a milestone celebration. We’ll absolutely be back.

reviews.author: Nicole P
reviews.title: WOW! Reviews are correct ! LOUD !  LOTS of problems w this Fairmont. I do not know where to start :( AWFUL EXPERIENCE !
reviews.text:
Unbelievable for the price of this “RESORT “  do NOT Expect peace or quiet if you get the wrong building or room ! 
We just flew in from Florida where it is spring break ENOUGH  SAID .. but this resort is way worse noise wise . We flew an entire 6 hour day  to escape the chaos from FL spring break to walk into an absolute nightmare!  
The room is nice but 1st thing we noticed was a very loud Air conditioner! Ok no big deal . HOWEVER the bar noise is absolutely horrible outside our room ! It’s absolutely awful. I will be leaving a 5 night stay as soon as I can find a flight home ! It’s that bad ! A long travel day to be so excited to see this so called magnificent property was maybe the biggest let down of my very well traveled life . 
Fairmont in all fairness has tried to make it right by giving us a new room , but we are not moving rooms after a very long day of travel at midnight , unpacking and time difference ..so  tomorrow we will give it a shot . As I write this I’m so disappointed. But we can’t sleep w the bar noise ! 
You really should not expect this at a Fairmont 5 star diamond property nor put up with it ! And just to unpack then repack was not on my agenda for a very expensive nightmare ! 
Very saddening to write this review because the staff is accommodating and trying to make it right !

reviews.author: Jennie C
reviews.title: Fabulous hotel and Beautiful summer days in winter !
reviews.text:
Fabulous hotel with amazing landscaped grounds.     Every cacti imaginable.    Orange trees with fragrant orange blossoms.    We stayed in Privado. Stunning rooms with fireplace and terrace overlooking the golf course with views of the mountains.   So luxurious and comfortable.  
The spa was heavenly, beautiful pools and amazing restaurants….   Steaks are incredible!Looking forward to next winter escape!    Thank you.    🤩 🤩🤩

reviews.author: Philip R
reviews.title: Beautiful location. Excellent restaurant.
reviews.text: A top-notch location with beautiful landscaping, friendly staff, and great amenities. Dinner at the on-site restaurant, Toro, was excellent on its own (empanadas, scallops with pork belly, and salmon) but was made even more special by the attention given to us by manager Sarah and server Jeff!

reviews.author: Russ N
reviews.title: 5-star family experience.
reviews.text: Absolutely awesome experience. From Chana Barksdale checking us in to amazing service, food, the spa - pretty much everything throughout our stay - it’s all been terrific. 5-star experience.

reviews.author: travel
reviews.title: Outstanding Guest Service
reviews.text:
First time staying here. Attended a conference for work. 

As usual, a need to call front desk arose a few times and I was assisted by Rosie. She was extremely resourceful and helpful in taking care of my questions. She sent someone to my door within minutes to resolve the issues.

Although everything was great, it was her attitude and eagerness to help that really stood out during my stay..

reviews.author: Christina S
reviews.title: Always a wonderful stay at The Fairmont
reviews.text: We had a wonderful experience at the Fairmont Scottsdale Princess. Everyone went above and beyond to accommodate our requests and make us feel like we were truly on vacation. The front desk, particularly Collin, was gracious and kind making sure we were taken care of. A shout out to the housekeeping staff who did a fabulous job keeping our room neat and tidy and for being very detailed - we appreciate it!

reviews.author: Karl G
reviews.title: Business Conference Visit- Great
reviews.text:
To be completely honest with you, EVERYTHING about this property is amazing, BUT the worst fitness Center.

six (6) cardio machines and One (1) Dumbbell rack.   An enormous property with Seven (7) ongoing conferences creates a traffic jam at 6 am when all the business travelers  want to get in a quick, executive workout.

Everything is great, please modernize the fitness center.  

Travel Tip:  Eat at La Hacienda and try the carne enchiladas.   It comes with a chocolate style sauce and the fatty meat paired with the chocolate taste is amazing.

reviews.author: Michael C
reviews.title: Top notch experience!
reviews.text: Quite impressed with the room design, furnishings, and overall layout. Felt very comfortable. The only complaint I have was a bed that was not as supportive as I like, but that is purely on me. The grounds are gorgeous, the atmosphere is inviting. Very pleasant experience.

reviews.author: Tom B
reviews.title: Wonderful Experience, Julio is a Super Star.
reviews.text: Came for a company retreat and training conference.  My first encounter was with Julio, who took me to my room, mapped out how to get to places of interest around the property, and even took me to the meeting room after filling my ice bucket so I could fill my yeti mug with cold water before we left the room.  He was more than professional, he was thrilled to be of service, spoke of his love for the company and immediately left a lasting impression on me that set the tone that has has been kept up throughout my stay.  Truly fantastic experience.

reviews.author: David S
reviews.title: Short stay
reviews.text: From check in to check out this was a must perfect experience. The staff are friendly and helpful and the room was perfectly fitted out and serviced promptly. This hotel sets the standards we expect but are sadly lacking elsewhere

reviews.author: chestpain
reviews.title: Another great visit
reviews.text: Thank you Fairmont Princess for another great vacation experience.  We always stay in the Fairmount Gold section for access to the lounge.  The Fairmont Gold Lounge makes all the difference.  Thank you to the awesome staff in the lounge.  I tried to tip them well to show our appreciation.  We staying in room 6416 with a great view of the golf course.  We can't wait to return.

reviews.author: Curiosity784860
reviews.title: World Class Resort + World Class Staff!!!
reviews.text: This was our second trip to the Fairmont Scottsdale Princess and this resort simply gets better with time!  The staff are world class, the rooms are gorgeous + serene and the grounds are remarkable.  We got a gold room and were completely WOWED!!!  From the private check in, club and spa access and overall support...we felt like royalty.  Specifically, Jen Dallas, Julia Heitz and Brian Ward, YOU are the people who help make the Princess stand out.  You were engaging, respectful and fun.  You made us feel so very special our entire stay!!  The spa was also just fantastic - from the fitness center to the steam/sauna/cold plunge area to the private pool...we never wanted to leave.  There is just so much to rave about!!!

reviews.author: Al R
reviews.title: Bad people bad people. Period.
reviews.text: People suck. Service sucks. Never seen anything like it or I feel like they are looking to us for admiration. I’m never coming back here again.

reviews.author: Debra Lynne Williams
reviews.title: Girls getaway
reviews.text:
The hotel is beautiful of course. Colin, Austin and Lauren were wonderful at check-in. Austin was even kind enough to comp our parking as my friend is an amputee. So friendly and welcoming. JAMES at the iron skillet was very warm and made us feel at home. He always checked on us consistently and took such great care of us and made us feel very special.

The highlight of the trip was Toro. And the highlight of Toro with Sarah. Who I believe is the assistant manager. She was incredibly warm, welcoming, and made us feel like we were the most special people there at the restaurant. We cannot say enough about her. She made the experience absolutely epic. I wish I remembered her last name. I think it was Some kind of Japanese last name. And she had the most wonderful smile. I just want her recognize. She just went so far above and beyond to make us feel so so special. Cuba was our server and he was wonderful. Brent was also great. He has such a great sense of humor.

You guys are doing something right at that restaurant. It was amazing. The food was amazing the dessert the little drink before our meal. Ev such an amazing staff there

reviews.author: Odyssey317459
reviews.title: Loud music late into the night every day.
reviews.text: Staying here is similar to trying to sleep above a night club or trying to sleep in the middle of a raging rave party. We stayed in section D near the lobby/Plaza bar. The first night the loud music didn’t end until past 11pm. The next night the music didn’t end until past 2am. This is very surprising for a AAA five diamond resort. If you ever come here, refuse any rooms near and around the Plaza bar or lobby. The hotel is beautiful and well maintained but the guests really should be able rest and sleep at night. Major fail here in my opinion.

reviews.author: carlton f
reviews.title: Don't waste your time.
reviews.text: Not worth the money. The whole place smelled like sewage. It was disgusting. Everything was way over priced.  $78 for 2 kids to ice skate. Everything was hours wait in lines. Skip this and go to Zoo lights.

reviews.author: Veronica C
reviews.title: No recommeded experience
reviews.text: There is nothing new in the Christmas experience. There are long lines due to having very few attractions and too many people. Food prices are high, the decorations are the same as in previous years, and overall it is not a recommended experience.

reviews.author: Chino083
reviews.title: Christmas at Princess (Privado)
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Privado which was absolutely fantastic. Big shout-out to Chana who was so warm & welcoming. Orlando handled our reservations happily. Heidi greeted us on several occasions & asked if we needed anything. The casita was beautiful & so peaceful. We felt tucked away & the serenity was really nice for all of us. The private lobby was well equipped. We enjoyed coffee there in the morning & their charcuterie offering at 4pm. As a a guest at Privado, we were spoiled with the golf cart private transportation. They took us to dinner reservations in addition to pools opposite the property. Eli & Jake are always so eager to see if we need any transportation or assistance and we all enjoyed chatting with one another. We went during Christmas at the Princess. One of the biggest perks was the VIP wristbands for Privado guests. We saved so much time for the ferris wheel, tube ride & train. Lights all around the resort were stunning!

Privado service was impeccable & I would not hesitate to book it again. The restaurants at the resort fell short in our opinion. We dined at multiple establishments. The service was very slow & the food was frankly not what you would expect from a 5-star resort. Bourbon Steak was a big let-down. My wife had to send her steak back because she ordered a medium temperature steak & they brought her one that was more on the the well-done side. Drinks there were not all too impressive either. 

My oldest son was interested in the kids club. We called one morning to see what they had on schedule and they admitted no one has signed up at all for that day. We didn't  bring him in because we didn't want him to be by himself. We did visit multiple times to allow the kids to enjoy themselves. They had basketball, ping pong, skeeball & other games. 

The Splash Pool (family pool) was freezing because the pump broke. It was such a shame because my kids were so excited to go on the water slides. I know these things happen. Luckily, the resort had other pool options. We mainly frequented Sunset Beach because of the location & service. 

All in all, we had a very good stay. Privado definitely lives up to the hype. However, the food options at the resort left a lot to be desired, especially at Bourbon Steak.

reviews.author: Kevin N
reviews.title: Scottsdale Princess-No Five Star Resort
reviews.text:
This is not a 5 star hotel pure and simple. 
We had the second best room in all of the resort (only because we were told our room was going to hear loud music until almost 11 pm) due to the Christmas event. I thanked them for sharing but the room they suggested was much more costly. I asked for some relief and they would not discount it but it cost me a $1000 more a night and I accepted it.. I started listening to every person who was checking in and it seems there was a bait and switch system going on with a similar story as they told me to each person checking in as well. 

We had to call Concierge to have our room cleaned. (Second best room level below Presidential Suite and that’s what we have to do?)

We had passive service from our concierge and asked for a one hour later check out and they said NO. 

There was a $130 vehicle charge which did not come with the room at that level. It was only until we complained where this was adjusted. 

No restocking of the amenities in the room. 

It seems the management does not care about loyalty. I have stayed at 5 stars and other quality Fairmonts and this is not one of them 

One of the front desk supervisors asked me how he could remedy our stay. I told him I am not looking to get a free stay but it was up to them. 

I never heard back. 

There are many  other high quality resorts in Scottsdale. But it does seem they love the Christmas season because the massive amounts of people who attend the holiday event and it looks nice. 

And this is the first time I have ever written such a complaint that I remember.

reviews.author: gil m
reviews.title: Very disappointing customer service
reviews.text: We were sent a discount for their Christmas celebration after some family went last week. I had trouble using it so I reached out. Spoke with Reese who said she would look into it and reach back out. Well she never reached back out. So I followed up and heard from another rep who told me the discount code is no longer valid. Well that sucks because now its unaffordable for me to bring the 9 members of my family.  Would be nice if people follow through with what they say they will.

reviews.author: Conrad M
reviews.title: DO NOT go to Bourbon Steak house.
reviews.text: Christmas at the Princess was a magical experience a few years ago, this year was not. We ate at Bourbon Steak house and it was absolutely terrible. The service was very slow but only to our table, the table next to us had multiple servers and were always taken care of. The food was abysmal, DO NOT go for the Lobster PotPie, not worth the $135. The wagyu steak also came out cold. The restaurants fix to that was giving us a shot of tomato soup? The server we had was disrespectful and inadequate. Now back to the actual hotel, the room stayed a cool 75 degrees so if you run hot then you will sweating during the night. Overall the princess is a good stay but please do not go to Bourbon Steak.

reviews.author: Lori A
reviews.title: Never again
reviews.text: Major disappointment!  Staff is rude, wait times are equivalent to Disney rides, lights were not impressive and everything is ridiculously priced.  Save your money, not worth it.

reviews.author: scott j
reviews.title: Christmas at the princess
reviews.text: Christmas at the princess is truly magical.  The activity’s and Christmas decor all over the resort are top tier.  Service and accommodations at the hotel are amazing per usual.  This is an experience that my family will remember and cherish forever.  The amount of work they put into the Christmas theme is truly unbelievable.  I don’t think even Disney puts this much effort into the Christmas theme.  We have made it tradition to spend thanksgiving week at the princess and it just seems to get better every year.  The thanksgiving day brunch was truly spectacular as well.  The service is always where this resort shines.  Keith at bell services, Filasita at fire and ice, and Justin in VIP services all did a phenomenal job with accommodating us and making us feel like family.  We are already planning our next year’s trip to Christmas at the princess.

reviews.author: BJB225
reviews.title: Nice, but not as nice as the Empress
reviews.text: As far as resorts go, this one seems very nice and is probably one of the nicer places to stay in the area. We like Fairmont hotels, but this experience clarified that we’re hotel people more than resort people, as we prefer the Empress to the Princess. That said, the room was nice and bed was comfortable. We had a very nice little balcony with a beautiful view. Service at the restaurant for breakfast was great. I think we had the same server three days in a row, but she was awesome and even let me order somewhat off the menu due to some dietary restrictions. She was great. Service in the bar area in the evening wasn’t as good. We went down because my husband wanted to investigate the cigar selection. We ended up finding menus and taking a look at the humidor on our own without anyone coming or offering to assist us. That was really the only blemish to the experience though. The staff in the entry/valet and in reception were all very kind and helpful. Overall I would recommend this as a nice place to stay.

reviews.author: MrsG
reviews.title: Christmas Magic in beautiful Scottsdale
reviews.text:
I cannot say enough good things about our experience at the Fairmont! There was such great attention to detail in every way, right down to the exclusive signature toiletries. We stayed two nights in the Private Casitas, and I don’t think I would do anything differently for future trips. First off, the staff makes the experience exceptional. Everyone was amazing and it was clear that guest satisfaction was their top priority. 
The room was so comfortable and spacious. I normally don’t sleep well away from home, so the comfort of the room was a big plus for me because I was able to get some good sleep. Each day in the Privado lobby, there’s an assortment of snacks to enjoy between meals. In the morning we had a lovely assortment of pastries which included a savory scone that I can’t stop thinking about. Afternoons there’s a sweet & salty trail mix and a charcuterie in the evening. The food we ordered from room service was perfection. We had the garlic hummus, wings, burgers, and more. 
We had our kiddo with us, so during the day we had a chance to try the Sunset Beach and other pool areas. Every little detail was perfect.
In the evenings, we went to Christmas at the Princess and our seven year old was delighted. We were thoroughly entertained by the singing trees and penguins! We also had a great train ride through a thoughtfully decorated Christmas light display throughout the property. There were lots of rides for all ages. We even tried a little ice skating. We won’t be going pro anytime soon, but it was a blast!! 
We finished the evening with s’mores and a grand finale light show on the water. It was truly a magical experience of a lifetime that everyone should try at least once!

reviews.author: LMF
reviews.title: Disappointed in service and guest experiences vs. the beauty of the resort
reviews.text: While this property is absolutely stunning and the Christmas at the Princess event was great, I am disappointed at the customer service in various sectors. Upon arrival at front desk no one offered to provide the wristbands I needed for my reservations to the Christmas hotel, I had to ask the agents if I received wristbands and what was included but they could not help me and didn’t know much about my reservation or the event itself. The concierge was very helpful, Andrew was great. Once we went to our room there were dirty plates, glasses, and napkins on the floor in front of our door. We went to have a drink at the main bar and no one greeted us. We sat for a good 5minutes until we were finally greeted. We asked for an old fashioned and they filled the cup with ice! It tasted terrible and was extremely watered down. The drinks were not worth the value at all, and the lack of customer experience made it even worse. We finished our drinks and not once were we offered another one! Missed opportunity to keep us there. The best parts of our stay were Chateau Champagne where Emery was awesome and extremely attentive, and dinner at Bourbon Steak. Robert was absolutely amazing! Very attentive and offered us so many delicious items from the menu. Overall, while the resort is stunning the staff needs better training on elevating the customer experience.

reviews.author: Scott C
reviews.title: Poor policies!
reviews.text: I was scheduled to stay at the Fairmont Princes 12/1 - 12/4 for a conference. I have stayed at the Fairmont Princes on other occasions.  The day before my stay, several family members tested positive for covid. In an effort to not be a carrier, and possibly infect other guest I canceled my reservation.  At that time I was told that there would be no refund, and no credit for my $1000 deposit.  It seems like a very poor policy, and treatment for someone trying to be socially responsible and not risk any other guest!

reviews.author: Happiness56044053940
reviews.title: Stay away!
reviews.text:
This was the worst “luxury” resort experience of my life. We called the booking line to book adjoining rooms for our stay and requested a quiet room for our enfant. We were told both rooms had to be the same type to adjoin, so we paid extra for two kind rooms. On arrival they told us that there are NO ADJOINING king rooms on property and we would have to accept a downgrade with no refund. 

With respect to our request for a quiet room so our enfant could nap, they put us in the heart of the Christmas lights carnival, mere yards from a roller coaster !

The food at the pools looks like prison slop in a tv dinner tray. It is not becoming of a “luxury” resort. They also have gross fried food stands set up everywhere to accommodate the thousands of visitors to the property who are not hotel guests. Do not expect a relaxing experience!

Finally, we were never advised that cash is not accepted at the lobby on check out, in all of the times we charged food and spa to our room (from four different restaurants). I prefer to pay cash because I bought USD when CAD was stronger. Paying card would effectively cost 10% more at minimum. The fairmont offered no solution despite never warning us that cash is not accepted in the lobby. I had to ask them to print each bill out while I was scrambling to get to the airport, and then run around the property from restaurant to restaurant to pay my bills one by one with cash!! They offered no apology or help for this humiliating solution. And then, the cherry on top is that they charged my card anyways! On top of the cash I paid for the same amounts ($2,000 approximately). I’m now dealing with the disputes department of my credit card because when I alerted Fairmont to the double charge they said they’d get back to me when a manager was in. 

DO NOT STAY HERE! do yourself a favour and pay a few extra bucks to stay at the four seasons. They have a better golf course there anyways and the TPC makes every group take a four caddy! Nothing like playing a round of golf with a Marshall in your group!

reviews.author: happyholidayToronto
reviews.title: Nice break
reviews.text: Loved the room (smaller than expected) and the view of the pool/golf course but what was noteworthy was the staff service; They had people in golf carts driving around offering to take you places.  The front desk; concierge and parking attendance were level 5.   The spa surpassed the CamelBack spa.     Mexican restaurant on site was good.  We left a bag by the table and their security delivered immediately.  The restaurant for lunch on the patio was adequate.  We were there in April and it happened to be a cold snap. The fire pits were a nice touch.  All in all nice break although I don't golf it appeared to be a beautiful course.  We didn't use the pools although there were many as the air was cold.

reviews.author: BostonExplorer32
reviews.title: 5 Star Experience.
reviews.text: Here for conference and stayed in enormous ‘Privado’ wing suite.  Check-in was fast and easy. Suite was very thoughtfully designed:  living room had desk, couch, working gas fireplace, coffee/espresso maker, hot water pot for tea, refrigerator.  Bedroom & bed comfortable, and quiet: slept like a baby.  Bathroom was very large with spacious walk in shower.  Everything worked.  Staff are terrific.  You get your steps in walking the large property, or can take one of the many roving golf carts offering rides to guests.  Conference facilities were first rate and food was fine.  We had a good dinner at Toro restaurant, accessible by shuttle. Checkout was fast.  They did put a mistaken minibar charge for 2 Cokes on my bill, but reversed it when I called.

reviews.author: JRDogMama
reviews.title: Back for more!
reviews.text: We booked one of the larger rooms in the Privado area, which did exist before; however, they've remodeled the units and added the private entry and building. Really enjoyed our 'villa,' proximity to everything at the property, and to the Privado building itself, where you can grab little snacks (think trail mix, cookies, meat/cheese/crackers depending on time of day), coffee, pop, or water complimentary, wine for a price. Our favorite pool is still the Privado pool and they've stepped-up the furniture that's in the area now, though they never did light either of the firepits any night that we were there. This pool is smaller, but hidden and meant to be exclusive to those in the Privado area. The other pools are slammed, particularly with families and kids. We did have an adjoining door on our villa, which isn't ideal, though I'm not sure if they're available without. The first couple of days there was a family on the other side of that door with little kids and they'd all SCREAM in the mornings, which was so terrible. Thankfully new guests moved-in for the second half of the week that were far more respectful with the volume of their voices. We also visited the spa, Privado guests get access to the entire spa (steam room, sauna, lavender-scented room, hot tub, and cold plunge), plus the rooftop pool and gym (classes daily that are great), so that was really fantastic. Facial was tremendous, highly recommend. Service overall at the resort is top-notch, every employee we encountered was friendly and kind. Only had one run-in at the Thanksgiving brunch where our server tried to get one over on us with the tip (attempted to get a double tip by not including it on the original receipt, so we had to ask to get it corrected), but the spread was phenomenal. Had lunch at Toro, which is right on the TPC course (short shuttle ride away) and highly recommend going over there. All the food was amazing, the atmosphere is really cool, and so fun to see that view of the course with all the stadium seating going up!

reviews.author: aa
reviews.title: Worst resort stay in my life
reviews.text:
I’m writing to share our experience because our recent stay at this resort was far from relaxing and nowhere near the standard we expected from a Fairmont property.

When we checked in, the bellman told us the only restaurant open was serving until 5pm. After a long day of travel, we rushed over—only to learn they had actually closed at 3pm. We ended up eating pool bar food just to get something in our system.

Once we finally got to our room, we tried to put our toddler down for a much-needed nap, but extremely loud music was blasting from outside. We called the front desk multiple times with no answer and even emailed the concierge because the noise was preventing our son from sleeping. At the same time, our AC wasn’t working, and repeated calls for help went unanswered. After several failed attempts to get our son to sleep, we had to give up and rush to dinner.

Dinner at La Hacienda was another disappointment. They do not make any modifications, and the meats are all heavily pre-seasoned—either extremely salty or spicy. The chef even refused to butterfly a filet. After sending back two meals, the only things we could actually eat were rice and chips. This is definitely not a family-friendly restaurant and not a place I’d recommend for anyone with dietary needs, kids, or simply wanting a relaxing meal.

On top of all this, the resort is hosting a massive holiday event. If you’re looking for peace or rest, this is not the place. The front desk assured us the music would end at 10pm, but it continued far beyond that night after night. It honestly felt like trying to sleep in the middle of a rave, times a hundred. They described it as “Disneyland in the desert,” and that’s exactly what it felt like. We had no idea what we were walking into.

Meanwhile, our AC issue continued for almost three days. It would randomly turn on and off, blowing hot or cold air on its own, and the constant temperature swings eventually got me sick. After more than 17 attempts, unanswered calls, and multiple “We’ll call you back” promises that never happened, it was finally confirmed that the AC didn’t work. Our parents’ AC was fixed sooner, but when they eventually moved us to another room, it ended up being in an even louder part of the resort.

Our spa visit was also disappointing. During my facial, the esthetician’s hands smelled strongly of garlic—even through her gloves. She mentioned she had been chopping garlic earlier, which was distracting and completely out of place for a luxury spa experience.

Between the noise, misinformation, lack of sleep, broken AC, unresponsive staff, disappointing dining, and the spa incident, this trip fell far below expectations. The repeated “How can we make it better?” lines felt scripted because nothing actually improved.

There were several more issues, but the bottom line is simple:

If you’re looking for relaxation, this is not the resort for you—especially during the holiday event season. Visit for the lights at night if you’re curious, but stay elsewhere if you value rest, quiet, reliability, or even basic follow-through.

Looking back, the disorganization, lack of communication, and constant misinformation should’ve been my first red flag that this resort just didn’t have its systems—or its guest experience—together.

reviews.author: S R
reviews.title: Great hotel in Scottsdale.
reviews.text: 2nd stay at this hotel and it doesn't disappoint. Rooms have been great both times. We did though have an issue with housekeeping. The hotel is trying to be more environmentally friendly so you can decide not to have your room serviced until the 3rd day for credit to your bill which we did. However our room wasn't serviced and we didn't get any credit. We had to find the housekeeping member of staff and request it be done which it was in the evening whilst we were out. Our friends had to ring on 4th day for theirs to be serviced. It doesn't put us off staying but probably puts us off trying to be 'green'. All staff we met were lovely and pools are fantastic. We went to the pumpkin fest whilst there and that was a little disappointing for adults much more for the children to enjoy.

reviews.author: “The T-R-S Stallion”
reviews.title: Holidays / Christmas at the Princess!
reviews.text: At the holiday/Xmas time, the property is decorated incredibly.  Kids will be in holiday heaven, as well as their parents & family!

reviews.author: Melina A
reviews.title: Awesome Hotel for our  Girls Trip !
reviews.text: We booked the Fairmont for our yearly girls trip and it did not disappoint.  A big thank you to the concierge staff who helped us plan our trip and gave us great recommendations !  A special thank you to Samantha from the concierge team !  The hotel is beautiful , rooms were clean and spacious and the on property restaurant Toro was delicious !!!!!

reviews.author: StefanieB
reviews.title: Excellent!
reviews.text: I had a situation where I needed to obtain a package while staying in this hotel. Samantha, at the concierge desk, found the package and notified me quickly and efficiently allowing me to enjoy the amenities at this beautiful hotel! Thank you!

reviews.author: Excursion608318
reviews.title: Amazing visit to the hotel, especially enjoyed The Gold Floor!
reviews.text: Fairmont Gold is amazing!  So nice to enjoy amazing food, coffee and beverages at all times of the day.  Breakfast was amazing!  The staff are incredibly friendly and willing to help you with anything.  We recommend this hotel and The Gold Floor.

reviews.author: NorthStar10178738013
reviews.title: Peace @ The Princess
reviews.text:
Hello, my name is Cornell Jackson. I came here with my mom and sister, and we had such a fantastic time. This is our favorite place to come to relax and clear our minds. I have attached a note of all the people who have made this experience special. 
P.s. how could I miss adding Shauna from Privado to the list! What a special lady. Shoutout to her as well. Thank you all and we will be back soon. Peace and blessings.

reviews.author: Jamie S
reviews.title: Best hotel ever
reviews.text: Best hotel we have ever stayed at. We have stayed here with our family atleast 10 times. We keep coming back bc it’s a gorgeous hotel, every detail is thought of, there are a million happy, helpful humans who make your stay comfortable. Fireworks every night over the Labor Day weekend, Derrek gave us a great golf cart tour of the property, even the cleaning crew is friendly and accommodating. We were trying to find our Waymo that was at the wrong pick up and one of the nice staff up front jumped on a golf cart and immediately took us to the pick up location. Alfredo at hacienda was fantastic, cannot get a better birthday day dinner (why we came!) experience than the Hacienda. Our favorite hotel. Cannot say enough good things!

reviews.author: annette6447
reviews.title: The only resort to stay in Scottsdale
reviews.text:
We recently stayed at the Fairmont Scottsdale Princess in a Privado One-Bedroom Suite, and it was truly one of the best resort experiences we’ve ever had. From the moment we arrived, the service was impeccable. Every staff member we encountered was friendly, professional, and eager to make sure our stay was perfect. A special mention goes to Chandra, who checked us in with such warmth and attentiveness—she made us feel immediately at home and set the tone for the rest of our visit.
The Privado experience itself was outstanding. Having access to the Well & Being Spa was such a highlight. The spa facilities were not only beautiful but also offered a variety of wellness classes and a well-equipped gym. Whether we wanted to relax or get in a great workout, there was always something available. It felt like the perfect balance of luxury and health-focused amenities.
The resort’s attention to detail in every area really stood out. Our suite was spacious, comfortable, and thoughtfully designed, making it an ideal retreat after enjoying all the activities and amenities around the property. We also appreciated the extra touches and privacy that come with staying in Privado—it truly felt like a resort within a resort.
Dining at the Princess was another highlight. The restaurants were all exceptional, offering not only delicious food but also a wide variety of healthy options, which we really valued. It’s rare to find such a perfect mix of indulgence and wellness-focused dining, and this resort delivers on both.
What impressed us most was how consistent everything was—whether it was housekeeping, concierge, dining, spa staff, or the Privado team, everyone seemed genuinely happy to be there and committed to making our stay memorable.
This hotel does everything right. We left feeling completely relaxed, pampered, and already planning our return. If you’re looking for a place that combines luxury, wellness, incredible dining, and exceptional service, the Fairmont Scottsdale Princess is it.

reviews.author: MuZicAlliAZ
reviews.title: One of the BEST days EVER in the Arizona sun 🏜️
reviews.text:
Where do I even start… Being handicap currently has definitely changed my view among other things. This experience opened my eyes and was a huge step forward, enjoy!! 

I spent the day at the Fairmont Scottsdale Princess Resort on 8/23/25 and it was honestly one of the best days I’ve had in a long time. This was my first solo outing in a year after some big health challenges, and I wasn’t sure how it would go. The staff made it feel easy, fun, and uplifting.

Right when I pulled up, my husband had already called ahead (he even joked with them about “Handicap Alli” 😆), so Gus was waiting the second my car door opened. Big smile, nice hat, helped with valet, and just made me feel completely taken care of. He introduced me to Nico, who helped with my walker and bag and walked me straight to the pool. That kind of thoughtfulness sets the tone for the whole day.

At the Splash Pool, Yazzy Yasmeen was amazing—she made me feel like her only guest. PK was great too, checking in often. I ordered a Caesar chicken salad wrap that was fresh and delicious, and the kiwi margarita was the perfect poolside drink.

I tried out a few pools during the day:
	•	The Slide Pool had great shade. My friend and her daughter stayed later for the 8 p.m. family movie there before heading to the fireworks.
	•	The Sandy Sunset Beach Pool was my favorite—the soft sand, fountain, and the fire features as the sun went down were just magical. Duke helped me at both the Slide and Sunset pools and he stood out as being really thoughtful and kind.
	•	I ended my night at the Princess Pool, which was quiet and peaceful. The only thing I noticed was that food/drink service stops at 6 p.m. at Sunset and Princess, which felt a little early since the pools stay open until 10 p.m.

Along the way I also met Sophie, who helped me out kindly mid-day, and I wrapped up with Dominique I believe was his name (brain injury and short term memory,eh), who left me smiling after a really nice conversation about Greece.

From an accessibility perspective, there are some things that could be improved (signage for ramps/lifts, the hot metal rails in the sun, and easier ways to get a shuttle—maybe even a text line). But overall, the staff made me feel supported every step of the way.

This wasn’t just a pool day for me—it was a milestone in regaining my independence. I left feeling happy, confident, and already planning to return, this time with my husband so we can enjoy it together (and finally stay for the 9 p.m. fireworks).

I highly recommend this resort and the overall beautiful property, amazing pools, and a staff that truly cared during my visit. Looking forward to next time!

reviews.author: kaveloz
reviews.title: Most gorgeous place I've ever been to
reviews.text:
Have not seen a hotel as beautiful as this, there is no where in it's vast property that lacked, it was jaw dropping. We used golf cart pick ups often, since we were in the segregated gold club section. Breakfast and afternoon snacks were plentiful and the customer service top notch. Go to the steak restaurant, it was excellent.

The only thing to keep in mind, is to make sure that you are billed appropriately when you leave, as they sometimes add some fees that they should not.

reviews.author: Megan P
reviews.title: Magical
reviews.text: This resort is absolutely beautiful!! The staff were so friendly and accommodating too. We came here for my sister’s bachelorette weekend and they had a beautiful welcome gift for her and treated us like royalty the whole time!! The grounds are stunning, the spa was amazing (best massage I’ve ever received), the room was so comfortable (and HUGE)! We loved every moment and cannot wait to go back!

reviews.author: Allen S
reviews.title: Fairmont Waterfront Hotel, Vancouver
reviews.text: Our experience at the Fairmont Waterfront Hotel in Vancouver was excellent.  The entire experience, from arrival to departure was memorable.  All the staff - at the Concierge desk, the lounge, the restaurant - were extremely friendly, courteous and willing to go out of their way to help, whether it was in making tour reservations to restaurant recommendations and reservations.

reviews.author: tom l
reviews.title: Outstanding weekend
reviews.text: Everything was incredible from the moment we arrived.  Service, food and all staff members were just amazing.  I can never stay anywhere else!

reviews.author: Manowar007
reviews.title: Think twice about visiting the heaving masses at the Spa
reviews.text:
My girlfriend had raved about the resort as her happy place so she convinced me to go. In general the service was impeccable, the pools were nice as was the room. My major issue was the Spa. She had gotten us a couples massage which had access to all the spa facilities. Our first unpleasant surprise was walking in with our pool noodles only to be told they were banned because of a previous "incident" (what kind of dangerous incident can you have with a pool noodle??? And also, how incompetent are you that you allow one buffoon to ruin the experience of countless others? Smacks of sheer lazy "well this mediocre bad thing happened so the easiest solution for us is to just ban every noodle"). The massage itself was phenomenal, and the basic spa facilities (steam room, sauna, cool dipping pool etc.) were nice. However, the pool was a mad house. Every seat was taken and there were people constantly scrambling for chairs. Apparently there had been zero thought to capacity planning, especially since they had sold a ton of day passes to locals. The noise was constant, not even remotely calm. The pool itself used to have big floaty chairs which had been removed, I guess for their deadly potential. The misters that used to be part of the framework to cool people had been removed as part of renovations. Even basic maintenance seemd to be overwhelmed, as the coffee maker was blocked, and then when unblocked there was no milk in it. Basically this calming $250/person spa was a Times Square Zoo. After all the praises my girlfriend had sang about the spa, it was extremely disappointing.

I don't know how this hotel compares to others in the area, but we're definitely going to investigate.

reviews.author: FellowTraveler659758
reviews.title: Major construction and disruptive jack hammering.
reviews.text: Here to celebrate my 40th birthday. Overall the hotel is incredible, great staff and beautiful property. Would normally give this hotel 5-stars. However, the entire property is under construction constantly jack hammering, grinding, hammering etc. The princess pool was under total renovation which is not something we were told about ahead of time. In the future guests should be made aware of major construction projects and disruptive noise prior to their stay.

reviews.author: Charlie M
reviews.title: Best anniversary weekend ever!
reviews.text: This was our first time staying at the Fairmont Princess and I must say, it exceeded our expectations on every level! The resort is absolutely gorgeous. The restaurants are wonderful, and the staff is very friendly. I highly recommend this resort to anyone who wants to do a staycation or visiting from out of town!

reviews.author: Howard M
reviews.title: Top Resort and Sophistication
reviews.text: What a treat!  Even though my stay was brief, I got a great sense of the property. So much so that I contracted for a company retreat next April for 275 attendees. They will be thrilled.

reviews.author: suer889
reviews.title: Great customer experience in an AZ luxury resort
reviews.text:
The Fairmont is a beautiful family resort with its barometer pointed toward luxury. It is a huge property on 65 acres with 750 rooms. In addition to a hotel, there  are villa casitas and perhaps other accommodations that I did not see. My hotel room was pretty average with a few upscale amenities like bathrobes and steamers in the closet. This is where my customer service story starts. First it is July in Arizona and the temperatures reached 116. So when I couldn’t get my room to stay cool, I was up every couple of hours the first night to turn the air down because the thermostat insisted on turning itself up. Since I was speaking at a conference, I had brought a pink jacket and was delighted to see a steamer in my closet because the jacket had wrinkled in my suitcase. However, when I used it, it put a couple of black residue spots on my jacket. I had received a text message from the hotel staff previously welcoming me and inviting me to let them know if I needed anything. So I texted the issues with the temperature and the steamer. Some lovely person named Simone took care of all of this for me right away. When I came back to my room that evening, my room was cool and my jacket had been  sent to the cleaners and was hanging fresh in my closet with no stains. Super customer service. 

There are some lovely high end restaurants, and the conference food was amazing. Something you don’t always say about conference food- but it was truly a gourmet delight. I saw four pools on the property, and the overall cowboy ranch suited the Arizona southwest vibe to a tee. Even the valet parkers were wearing cowboy hats. 

Hats off to the  Princess for a lovely Arizona luxury resort experience.

reviews.author: Tim F
reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.text: Great hotel and the employees were so helpful and friendly. Sophia the bartender at the pool was outstanding and went above and beyond to accommodate us. We would definitely come back.

reviews.author: LauraW
reviews.title: Staff was very nice but...
reviews.text:
There is a lot of walking involved at this place inside and outside!  I went for a conference.  I walked 10 miles in 4 days.  The theme is great, really cute places to take pics.  The on-site restaurants were ok, of course a lot of spicy food, so be prepared for that! The vegetarian options were really not very good at all.  The staff is very helpful and friendly.  There were little things that were annoying, no hot water in my room (C1025).   The handle kept falling down so I had to secure it in the supposedly "hot" position with a hair scrunchy, but still no hot water, lukewarm at best.  Strange comment, but the doors (to my room and other places) had so much space around them when closed. It seems like they would want the AC to be as efficient as possible?! As a result, my room really didn't get nice and cold like I like to sleep.  The cover options on the bed were either a sheet or a hot comforter.  The king rooms are set up nice and are very spacious.  I loved having a balcony to sit on in the morning.  The lack of good signage got us lost (which accounts for some extra walking outside).  We had a formal dinner the last night in the Princess Ballroom, which was very nice.  We got all dressed up in our rooms, did our hair, walked outside to walk to the conference center and the hot air just ruined our hair. 
On my last night there one of the workers was rolling around a cart on the second floor outside at 10:47 p.m.  Very noisy.  I couldn't get to sleep.  Also, I didn't see any  recycling bins.  The stores on site were outrageous.  Not just the clothing stores but even T-shirts ($50) and first aid supplies.

reviews.author: JetSetnGo
reviews.title: Polished on the Outside, Crumbling Within...
reviews.text:
This property has so much potential—with beautifully refreshed outdoor rooftop pool spaces and truly excellent spa staff including that of the Sisley Spa that rivals services received  in France. From the outside, it feels like a five-star experience waiting to happen.

Unfortunately, that was overshadowed by serious maintenance issues that are hard to ignore: spa showers with poor drainage, visible signs of water damage and mold, and what seems like leaky plumbing behind the walls. These aren’t minor cosmetic flaws—they’re red flags that indicate the infrastructure needs urgent TLC. It’s especially disappointing considering how strong the guest-facing amenities are.

The property desperately needs a full technical inspection and facilities refresh to match the polished image it’s trying to present.

reviews.author: R Dutta
reviews.title: FAIRMONT SCOTTSDALE
reviews.text: Very big resort in Scottsdale. Has a golf course and 3 swimming pools and lots of leisure activities including many for kids. Hotel also has a very upscale and big spa. Hotel has very attentive and praiseworthy Concierge and Reception sevices. Rooms and bathrooms are spacious . No bathtub in such a upscale resort is a miss. Room service is good and breakfast is buffet and good spread. Hotel has many restaurants.  We tried the Mexican. It was very good including the service.

reviews.author: sonofredhand
reviews.title: This Princess has aged
reviews.text:
Rating: 6/10

My family and I stayed in a King room for one night in April 2025.

Positives:
• The heated pool and water slides were a definite highlight for the kids, even with the rainy, cooler weather. They had a blast.
• Ironwood American Kitchen stands out as a top-tier resort breakfast buffet—fresh options, good service, and a lively atmosphere.
• The Plaza Bar was a great spot to unwind and catch up with a large group of friends. The drinks were solid, and the small plates hit the mark.
• From the valet to the front desk to the restaurant team, the staff were uniformly friendly, attentive, and professional.

Negatives:
• As with other Fairmont properties I’ve visited, this resort feels dated and in clear need of a refresh—both inside and out.
• The pricing feels out of step with the current condition of the property. Given the many newer, better-maintained options nearby, it’s hard to see the value here.

reviews.author: HotelSnobHannah
reviews.title: Fairmont Fantastic!
reviews.text:
(This review is for the Fairmont Scottsdale Privado.)

On a recent family vacation to Scottsdale, HSH had the pleasure of being spoiled by the Fairmont Scottsdale Resort, Privado Villas.  The entire property is stunning but the Privado section and suites are truly breathtaking.  From the moment we arrived to the private Privado entrance, we knew would we have a flawless week.  The entire Privado concierge team made check-in easy.  They thoroughly discussed the room, property, activities, and anything else you might be interested in.  They are all highly trained and very professional - the best of the best.  (Special kudos to Chelsea and Bradley for helping us with a few complex needs we had.) 

The entire Privado front drive/valet team was incredibly friendly, respectful, and always available to drive you in a golf cart.  Eric especially was so wonderful on the day of our arrival - he helped us get checked in and drove the whole family to our various rooms.

The property itself is wonderful.  There are many, many pools to pick from and a fantastic spa facility on property as well.  The spa hosts a variety of fitness classes each day which are included if you are a Privado guest.  We participated in Aerial Yoga and Aqua Fitness.  Both were great classes and something different to try while on vacation.

The food on property was also a treat.  We ate at La Hacienda one evening.  Food and service were both excellente!  In room dining was A+++.  Pool menu and food (specifically salads and bowls) - also fantastic. We lastly dined at Bourbon Steakhouse one evening.  Service was spectacular and food was delicious. 

I could write a novel about how fantastic of a resort this is.  I will not bore you with more paragraphs of details but instead provide the traditional HSH pro/con/recommendations list:

Pros:
* The staff!  Every single employee we encountered on the property was wonderful
* Privado club house has endless supply of water, coffee/tea, and snacks.  The snacks were delicious and we looked forward to a little treat each day
* Privado had its own private entrance with optional valet and very close self parking
* In the bedroom, everything was wonderful and beautiful.  The little things made the room extra cozy.  In particular:
    * Wireless chargers on both sides of the bed
    * Ceiling fan in bedroom
    * Two sinks completely separated (see photo)
    * Nail care kit in bathroom - how smart to provide!
    * There was a full blown steamer and dressing area within our bathroom.  Amazing detail that I didn’t know I needed 
    * Regular coffee maker AND electric tea kettle in room for any type of hot beverage you could possibly need
    * Balcony off room had table with 2 chairs. We spent a ton of time on the balcony - it’s a great extension of the room
* Delicious in room dining breakfast options… we could have ordered the overnight oats everyday
* F&B credit if you didn’t get housekeeping

Cons:  NONE

Recommendations:
* Can the auto closet light be on a dimmer?  We loved the automatic light but it was a bit jarring in the middle of the night if you got up
* Bathrobe material in room was a little rough
* Recommend second floor room if you like high vaulted ceilings.  Recommend first floor room if you don’t want to climb the steps after a long day

Theoretically, if I had to be stuck at a domestic resort and could not leave the property for a few weeks, Fairmont Scottsdale would be one of my top choices. We had a fantastic week there.

reviews.author: Jordan M
reviews.title: Perfect Getaway
reviews.text: Gorgeous property - rooms and grounds are top quality.  Love the beach pool - lots of kids but still enough spaces to get away for couples.  Dining options are pricey but so worth it!  The staff were all top notch - drinks by the pool came quickly and often!  Will be back.

reviews.author: MGoBlue99
reviews.title: Luxurious spring break vacation.
reviews.text:
We came to Scottsdale for spring break with one other family, and spent half of our vacation at the Fairmont Princess. Here is my review of the resort:

GROUNDS: The resort itself is very pretty. There are plenty of walking trails, and we enjoyed exploring it. It's not too large that it overwhelms you though. 

POOLS: We had a fun time at the various pools. We went to the main one next to Ironwood, as well as the splash pool with the slides. It wasn't very crowded when we were there, so it was easy to find pool chairs. The kids had fun at the slides, but I will see they are best suited for smaller kids (say under age 10). Drink and food service was fast.

ROOM: We booked a standard balcony room that felt very luxurious. The balcony had a great scenic view of the courtyard. It was relaxing just to sit there at night and feel the cool breeze. 
The room was quite large, and I liked that the bathroom was isolated from the rest of the room. You could use it at night or early morning and not wake up anyone that was sleeping. I liked the big shower and the dual vanity sinks. The one disappointing thing was that the shower pressure was not strong.
The beds and linens were amazing! They were so plush and comfortable.

DINING: We had lunch at Ironwood, which was fantastic! Everything we ordered there was very tasty. They also have a big kids menu. We also had one dinner at La Hacienda, which was expensive but great. Overall, the Princess food and drinks are not cheap, but at least you are getting high quality. We also ordered DoorDash breakfast one day (you have to meet the driver in the lobby).

KIDS CLUB: The kids club is free after 1pm, and our group had a blast there. They had all the fun things you would see at an arcade: games, foosball, ping pong, Pop-A-Shot, board games, Nintendo, skeeball, etc. And best of all, everything was free to play! We were there when it was empty, so it was an ideal way to spend a few hours.

SPA: The famous Spa is one of the main reasons we decided to book the Fairmont. It lived up to the hype. The facility is so luxurious and big. They even have their own gym. I had an hour magnesium massage, which was one of the best I've had.

Overall, we had a fantastic vacation at the Fairmont and I would highly recommend it.

reviews.author: pcftravel
reviews.title: Warning
reviews.text:
We just left the Fairmont Princess. 

The hot water faucet in our tub was spewing rusty/filthy water.

In shock, we called the front desk. They said "sorry we can move you to a different room." That was it. No one ever came to investigate. The lack of care or interest was a real eye opener. 

After leaving a day early, they never contacted us to make sure we are ok. We had been showering in that room for several days. Who knows how long this has been happening, and how many previous guests have been showering in rusty water without knowing it?

My next message will be to the health department.
