Stunning craft cocktails and marvelous service! Great time before take off to dinner. Superior!!!!

reviews.author: Kristina C
reviews.title: Great resort for a spring break getaway
reviews.text:
Excellent check-in, friendly and welcoming staff upon our arrival.
We took a golf cart to our building, we stayed in G building close to the Sunset Beach Pool. This pool was excellent for young families with a zero entry close to the sandy beach.
We had a 2nd floor view of the Casitas and it was very peaceful in the morning and evening to sit outside .
Room was spacious and well designed. Comfortable for a family with 2 young children. 
La Hacienda (Mexican) restaurant was great, the food was delicious, drinks and food were delivered pretty quickly. Staff were friendly and welcoming to families.
The fishing derby was fun, our kids tried fishing for the first time and loved it. They didn't catch anything but enjoyed watching other children when they did!

The Sonoran Splash pool had amazing waterslides that were a hit with our kids and the pool design created different areas to play in. The water temp was perfect so the kids could play longer! We always found plenty of lounge chairs available regardless of the time we arrived! 

Poolside service was ok, the servers were friendly and drinks arrived quickly but wait times for food were plus 30 mins.

There was a movie night Friday and Saturday in the Fragrance garden. Fantastic set up with fire tables and lounge chairs for the kids, amazing service, kids loved the popcorn and soda.
They played a different movie each night, both were family friendly.

Ironwood was closed for dinner our entire stay and we felt there was a lack of family friendly dinner options other than the Mexican restaurant. Our kids didn't want Mexican more than once so we ended up eating dinner at the Plaza bar twice and the food was consistent both times. I had the wedge salad and my husband had the cheeseburger both times, both delicious. They had an unofficial children's menu and our kids enjoyed the food. Service was friendly and the food arrived quickly.

We enjoyed using the trailblazers kids club in the afternoon for a break from the pool.

We enjoyed the many fire tables and wood burning fireplaces throughout the resort. What a great idea to have so many gathering places!

The daily housekeeping service was consistent but the nightly turndown service was not. One time they arrived after 9pm and we were already in bed! The other times they arrived either while we were getting ready for dinner or while we were out for dinner. One time they left 4 chocolates, another 2. One time they left water at the bedside table and another they did not.

I would like to mention that one of the housekeeping supervisors was absolutely amazing when our daughters favorite stuffed animal got sent to the laundry when the sheets were changed. After I called she immediately went searching for it in the laundry and rescued it and returned it within 15 mins! She made our little girl very happy!!

We visited the breakfast buffet at Ironwood twice. The eggs, potatoes and meat selections at the hot station were unfortunately cold, either the burners were not turned on or the lids had been left open. We absolutely loved the cold stations including the fresh donuts! The service was friendly and fast both times.

Overall we loved visiting the princess and plan to do so again in the future.

reviews.author: John S
reviews.title: Kid friendly yes, Quiet friendly, no
reviews.text: The positive first - the staff is very friendly and attentive, and the property is very clean and nice.  We’ve stayed here before, and had a great experience, but our mistake was that we came during spring break.  If you’re with a family, it’s great, but if you are expecting a quiet experience, not so much.  Kids everywhere and we couldn’t get away from the noise.  WE stayed at the Privado, which is their “hotel in a hotel”, which was at the end of the property.  They sell an upgraded experience, but frankly, it’s no different than the Fairmont Gold, and very expensive.  You also pay for the experience, which means that you get minimal snacks and muffins in the “clubhouse” and free waters and cokes.  The kids loved this, which means it’s full of kids and families, again, no place to sit down and enjoy a peaceful coffee.  We’ve learned our lesson.  Very expensive stay that was frustrating.

reviews.author: Trystan C
reviews.title: Friendly staff, Numerous problems
reviews.text:
Very nice staff who express concern amidst a comedy of errors.

From the moment of check-in (we arrived at 
2:30 our room being last one to be ready (30 minutes after official check-in time) 4:30 in the Privado area despite being told they had placed a rush on it.

First night one of the two sinks was clogged but remedied by staff within the hour. A short time after returning to the room the other sink did not drain.

First morning:  no running water from one sink and non-working shower. Again service arrival was satisfactory and friendly. Given the non-functional shower a room move request was made.

Request to be moved rooms was accommodated but could not be done understandably until after check-out time. After attending Spring Training game we returned to Privado at Fairmont and after undergoing another rather lengthy check-in process a different room was granted. 

However, prior to leaving for Spring Training game, we had been assured the luggage would be retrieved from original room and placed in new room.Surprise. No luggage.
After further time at the Privado check-in area I was able to receive assistance to transfer the luggage to new room. Again the assistance was pleasant.

reviews.author: Lauren
reviews.title: Bad vacation choice
reviews.text:
We chose this resort as a different option for a vacation in Scottsdale. (We’ve stayed at the Kierland & Gainey Ranch in the past.) Big mistake coming here.

There are two problems with this resort. The first involves the food. Every single restaurant is designed for a “foodie”. There are almost no regular options. Examples include brussel sprout tacos & omelette with kale. What’s wrong with offering classic breakfast options like choose-your-own omelette? How about having standard pancakes / bagels with lox / waffles on the menu? For dinner, especially at the Mexican-themed restaurant, why not offer fajitas / quesadillas, etc.? Kid menus do have a few of these options, but why force adults to eat “foodie” options? The coffee is also terrible. It’s ridiculously weak. Why can’t the serve strong coffee?

The other problem is the staff at the restaurants & at the bar at the Princess pool. They treat guests as if the guests are lucky to be staying at the hotel. The servers begrudgingly take the orders and then take forever to bring them out. 

The housekeeping staff is very nice, but they move your stuff around, like wires & devices. Why do they feel the need to unplug guests devices and move them to other locations? Several times we thought we lost items, only to find them grouped together in places we hadn’t left them.
They also don’t restock soap. 

The Princess management should go to the Westin Kierland to see what normal, good menus look like. They should also see how other hotels make more family-friendly areas (more public fire pits, s’mores packages, etc.). The Princess is only worthwhile if you golf. It’s a completely wrong vacation spot for families wanting a normal vacation.  Such a shame!

reviews.author: randy c
reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.text: Maybe it is timing but there were 2 large conventions while on property and it felt like being at a fraternity party.  25-30 year olds every where who were loud and intoxicated.  Property is huge and rooms nice.  Service disappointing, concierge were worthless.  Have stayed at multiple 5 star properties around the world and this is not.

reviews.author: GattoViziato
reviews.title: Outstanding stay
reviews.text:
This was truly a five star experience. From the time I checked into my villa, the staff was friendly and very accommodating.  Within the ch club lounge area there was complimentary drinks available.  The resort had numerous venues for breakfast, lunch and dinner. They also had an on site spa and other sporting accommodations available from pickleball to golf at some outstanding courses.  My villa was very nice, the bedroom has very relaxing and the bathroom was very spacious with jacuzzi and large walk in shower.  I also had a living room area with a  fireplace.

Overall great stay.

reviews.author: Eric K
reviews.title: **Avoid This Hotel at All Costs – Worst Customer Service Experience Ever!**
reviews.text:
If I could give this hotel zero stars, I absolutely would. My recent experience dealing with their reservation customer service team was hands down the most frustrating, unprofessional, and infuriating interaction I’ve ever had with a "luxury" hotel.  

I encountered a simple reservation issue where a room credit was not applied to my reservation despite that being in the advertised package. This was a simple issue that should have been easy to fix. Instead, I was met with nothing but rudeness, and complete disregard for customer satisfaction. The front desk staff were dismissive and unhelpful, essentially shrugging their shoulders instead of making any effort to resolve the situation. When I asked to speak with a manager, I was transferred to 5 different representatives. After waiting an absurd amount of time, I finally got in touch with a manager who, shockingly, was even more unprofessional than the staff. Instead of assisting me, they were condescending and defensive, acting as if I was the problem rather than a paying customer who simply wanted the reservation fixed and the room credit assigned.  

I spent HOURS on the phone trying to get this resolved, only to be transferred from one unhelpful representative to another. The easiest part of the process (and the best customer service) was when I called back to cancel my entire reservation and spa appointments (dodged a bullet by not staying here!)

This hotel desperately needs a lesson in customer service, professionalism, and basic hospitality. There are plenty of other places to stay—trust me, anywhere else is better than this nightmare.

reviews.author: Travelling Mama
reviews.title: Enjoyable stay at beautiful Sunset Suite
reviews.text:
As a Diamond member, we were upgraded to the Sunset Suite from Cholla Suite.  The Sunset suite was spacious and comfortable but it was a bit further away from the lobby area.  We didn’t mind the walk too much even with a stroller and enjoyed walking around the well manicured pathways.  

Our suite was always cleaned immaculately and stocked well with amenities.  The housekeeping provided was consistently good throughout the stay.  They also provided a diaper pail to use and a cute neck pillow to take home for kids.  The beds and pillows were extremely comfortable. 

It was much colder than expected in January but I was so happy to find out the pools were heated well.  The reception told me that all the pools were heated to the same temperature but this was definitely not the case.  The slide pool was the warmest and it was like a hot tub warm so we enjoyed even in the coldest January days.  We just had to run up to go on the slides because the air was much colder but it was such a relief in the warm water.  The other two pools were not as warm but I found the Sunset pool still warmer than the main pool.  The two hot tubs by the main pool were very warm but always crowded. 

The gold lounge was comfortable but their food selection was rather smaller than expected.  They did have pretty good drink options and the service was great. 

We tried Ironwood Restaurant for breakfast and lunch and it was good.  Their burger was especially good.  We also tried Hacienda Restaurant for dinner and we enjoyed everything we ordered.  Trio Guacamole and Arrachera were tasty.  I also enjoyed Shrimp Enchiladas. 

We used Uber, Lyft, and Waymo to all the places, and found it more convenient than renting a car.  Do not use Waymo to PHX airport unless you want to spend double the time on the ride as they do not go on the highway and we almost missed our flight!

reviews.author: Robyn D
reviews.title: Privado is the best of what the Fairmont Princess has to offer
reviews.text: Privado is a hotel-within-a-hotel at the Fairmont Princess. This has got to be the best hotel in the Phoenix area, bar none! You have all the amenities of the Fairmont BUT with the seclusion and privacy of your own villa, private lobby and conceriege staff. The Privado lobby has drinks and snacks all day long and staff that bend over backwards to help you. We will only stay here from now on, when we're coming to Phoenix. Thank you Privado!

reviews.author: Autumn0222
reviews.title: Christmas at the Princess
reviews.text: Enjoyed a long weekend at The Princess right before Christmas.  We booked this hotel to take part in the Christmas at The Princess activities.  Upon arrival the check-in line was very long, but moved pretty quickly.  Room was nice and the size and layout was perfect for our family.  We enjoyed the Christmas festivities and having the fast pass was great!   We did the Christmas activities every night!  During one of the days we rented a cabana at pool with the slides and did not have great service.  The next day we decided to book a cabana at the pool with the sand beach entry and had amazing service.  Evan was our waiter this day and he was great!  My only complaint about the pool is the food service was not great and is served in a plastic tray that I can only describe like an elementary school cafeteria tray or what I can imagine a prison food tray.  For a higher end resort the food presentation was terrible.  Also, all the pool drinks were served out of paper cups which also was a disappointment.  No one wants to drink cocktails out of cheap paper cups.  I would stay here again for the Christmas festivities, but it probably wouldn’t be my top choice for a resort compared to the other great resorts in the area.

reviews.author: Andimbo
reviews.title: Mixed experience
reviews.text: Just finished a four day stay at this hotel. Stayed in Fairmont Gold. Staff were friendly and super helpful. Room comfortable and spacious. The reason for the lower score was due to the breakfast being poor quality (I think there should have been a cooked breakfast) and all the extra charges on the bill like resort fee which I wasn’t expecting)..

reviews.author: BigDDetroit_MI
reviews.title: Feel like a super star in this magnificent hotel
reviews.text:
Our experience was excellent and felt luxurious. Pay the extra money to get a Fairmont Gold Suite. There is a separate lounge (with is own concierge) for Gold guests only. Breakfast and evening appetizers  are included in the lounge. We went during the Christmas lights. It was amazing and made you feel like you were at a carnival. The room itself is very comfortable. Get a room with a couch. Also, I wish we had a southern facing room to get the daylight sun on the patio (balcony). We went to two different pool areas. Everything was clean and comfortable. Get food at the pool shack.
Fish tacos were good. The Bourbon steakhouse was ok. Nothing fabulous. The food was good, but no bread with the meal. Instead, the first thing brought to the table was French fries with a couple of dipping sauces. Forget the French fries and offer bread. Very expensive. Dinner for two with no drinks was $300+. Lots of walking, but chauffeured golf carts save you some time. I want to go back.

reviews.author: Destination729034
reviews.title: Exceptional hotel with great people!
reviews.text:
My family and I had a very enjoyable and memorable stay at the Fairmont Scottsdale Princess.  The hotel itself is beautiful:  a luxury desert oasis.  Experiencing Christmas at the Princess was truly remarkable:  we enjoyed the 10 million+ lights; the loud, festive music; and the various activities.  

Most importantly, after deciding to upgrade to the Fairmont Gold experience, we received world-class service from the Fairmont Gold Concierge team:  Anna, Kylie, Brian, Ryan, Jelena, Madison, Julia and Elle.  

They were helpful, thoughtful and hard-working.  Kudos to the team and Fairmont leadership for delivering on the high standards of this prestigious Canadian brand.

reviews.author: Blair R
reviews.title: They understand hospitality and customer satisfaction.
reviews.text: Great property and rooms but the quality of the service I received was exceptional. Outstanding valet reception and front desk staff. Shoutout to Heath and Daniel who demonstrated superb hospitality skills. Because they listened to my requests and went above and beyond to satisfy them I’ll be back! Thank you so much Heath.

reviews.author: DougS78
reviews.title: Uneven experience due to insufficient staffing and space for number of guests.
reviews.text:
Extremely large resort, which means lots of amenities, but also lots and lots of guests plus long walks across property.  Overall our stay in the "Gold" section was pleasant, but failed to deliver on the high price one pays for the Fairmont Gold. The exclusive lounge area was always full the point of crowding. For example, we often had a challenge finding a place to sit together while eating breakfast.  The physical space is just too small for the number of guests that have Fairmont Gold access. Partially due to this, the breakfast and snack offerings, as well as furniture in the lounge, was less generous than other Fairmont Gold lounges. 

To be clear, the Gold staff were professional and very capable, but they are being asked to do more than is humanly possible with this many guests in such a small space. Similar can be said across the resort as very good staff members were there but not nearly enough! 

The room itself was nicely appointed although the bathrooms are a bit dated. Notably the housekeeping was uneven.  On the day of check in I was walking around and stepped on multiple cactus spikes! It seems clear the floor hadn't been cleaned effectively.  We reported this they eventually cleaned it again, but never even got an apology! 

Important context is that out stay was at the very end of the "Christmas at the Princess" which is a huge event at the hotel that runs from early November.  So staff are likely tired and needing time off after a busy holiday rush. However, if they are going to charge these prices and uphold the Fairmont experience, management needs to staff up appropriately!

reviews.author: Voyage51563234409
reviews.title: Poor experience.
reviews.text:
I purchased 4 tickets for 12-31-24 to go there just for the ice skating only. When I walked up with my family to get skates? They asked for our general admission ticket. Apparently you must have a general mission ticket as well. So paying  $170 for 4 tickets wasn't enough. We planned to spend 1 1/2 hours skating. But not quite yet mister!!

They wanted to reach in my pockets even deeper, another $45.00 per person for general admission so another almost $200. They said they state you need a general admission ticket on the website, Why would they let me buy ice skating tickets without the general admission tickets?? 

Clearly, if I need them both, I shouldn't be able to check out without buying both, Then I would know the true cost of the event and be able to decide if we still wanted to go. This seems awful tricky to me. They hook you in and probably feel when you get there you will just pay the difference since you're already there. We all decided we were not going to be taken advantage of, so we left without ice skating and went to do something different. This was our second time there, and our last time. Oh by the way you can't go up to a bar and buy a drink without the general admission ticket. Our opinion is they clearly only care about the money and not the customer experience.

4 Tickes $170.00
Self Parkung $40.00 or
Valet Parking $120
4 General admission tickets.$ 180.00

Never again Fairmont Princess Scottsdale... you lost more local customers :-(

reviews.author: Lydia C
reviews.title: Christmas at the Princess
reviews.text: Christmas at the princess was wonderful. Very family friendly. I would say it is better than Disney. The grounds were impeccable decorated. There were activities for everyone The restaurants and spa were wonderful. I highly recommend.

reviews.author: Jim H
reviews.title: Fairmont Scottsdale Princess is a Great Place for Holiday Lights and Activities
reviews.text:
The holiday lights and fun holiday activities made our stay for several days at the Fairmont Scottsdale Princess wonderful.  With extensive decorations throughout the entire hotel property, we spent every night visiting different holiday areas.  The train ride that runs throughout the property provided an easy way to see many of the lights and areas we wanted to visit when walking around.  

The Gold Floor section on the hotel property provided a restful, quiet area away from the evening light shows and music.  The Fairmont Princess Gold staff provided excellent service in the lounge and helping with restaurant and other reservations.  All Gold staff members were very helpful in answering questions and making recommendations so our stay was memorable.  The morning breakfast and afternoon canapes in the lounge are very nice.  Gold team members really focused on providing Great Customer Service!

The Plaza Bar was an excellent location for food and beverages plus experiencing the evening light shows and festive music.  Servers provided great recommendations for beverages and food.  

With all the holiday lights and attractions throughout the Fairmont Princess property, guests really do not need to leave the property.  The different style restaurants and bars also provided excellent options for breakfast, lunch and dinner.  We really enjoyed the golf carts hotel staff use to transport guests around the property throughout the day and evening.    We look forward to returning again.

reviews.author: Han L
reviews.title: Best family winter getaway!
reviews.text: This was our second time at the Fairmont Princess. We had a great summer last year and an amazing winter this year! The Christmas festival was just more than fun. Ice skating, mini golf, Ferris Wheel, sled, s’mores, city lights, music.. you name it! 5 hours of entertainment seemed to be too short! Can’t wait to be back!

reviews.author: NYCityTravelers
reviews.title: Nice stay for work
reviews.text:
Room 1404 had an excellent bed, good blackout curtains and a lovely, roomy bathroom.   Unfortunately, the outdoor space for my room overlooked parking spaces and the resort road/driveway that runs behind the building, so I never used the patio.  And the wooden slatted doors covering the sliding glass doors to the patio were off their track, so the wooden doors would not open.  Not a big deal for me, once I realized the patio overlooked parking spaces.

The building is about an 8 minute walk from checkin, restaurants and shop where ice coffee is sold.   

Lovely spa facilities where I had a terrific massage and facial.

reviews.author: Stephanie K
reviews.title: TOO MUCH MONEY - TOO LONG OF LINES
reviews.text: It has been a few years since we have attended this event, but we WILL NOT be going back. We went on a Monday night, and it took 1.5 hours to park THEN we had to take a shuttle to the hotel. We were not made aware of this change beforehand which was dissapointing. We bought all of our tickets beforehand, so I thought we would be able to skip some of the lines to get in, but that was not the case...what is the point of being prepared? Too many people were allowed in making each attraction 1 - 1.5 hour wait. Lastly, the one photo you get with santa is texted to you and it was blurry. We spent $300 on this experience and the hotel said we could submit an email for improvements.

reviews.author: LMIngram
reviews.title: Hoodwinked Christmas
reviews.text: We have stayed at the Princess several times before for their Christmas and Halloween (fall) events. This was, by far, the most sub-par stay we have experienced. The quality of our room was average at best (curtains coming down, the room was so stuffy that we had to open the patio door during the middle of the night, and the amenities for the Christmas event that were stated to be in the room, missing). But the Christmas event itself was abhorrent compared to years past. Ice skating used to be included for the event for overnite guests, no longer, and that was an additional $80 plus fees for our 2 teens. When I payed over $500 a nite for a basic room, I expected that to be included, especially since it has been before. The event was over crowded, the prices crazy, even for resort event standards- and don’t even get me started on the $100 entry fee for “Aurora Ice;” literally a refrigerated room with a few ice sculptures that you are ushered through. Even the employees felt badly for people and said they wished they could let  people know after I told them it was the worst $100 I had ever spent. I felt hoodwinked for sure- and for no reason. We spent plenty of money on $16 cocktails, and $7 canned cokes, $21 pretzels and $6 chocolate chip cookies. To then ask more of overnite guests seems insane and insincere. We won’t be back- there are other outstanding resorts in Scottsdale.

reviews.author: Alice L
reviews.title: Overpriced and tons of "extra" charges for days that are not even near Xmas dates.
reviews.text:
Overpriced and tons of "extra" charges for days that are not even near Xmas dates.

I had to bite the bullet and pay the $20 (per order number) "date change fee"...and then extra $20/individual ticket for non-"value date" tickets (this is AFTER Xmas date) + self parking fee change.  This will be the last time I ever buy anything from Fairmont. 

Definitely took the "magic" out of Christmas.  Plus, don't believe all you see in these marketing pics.  What a joke.

reviews.author: DCJ
reviews.title: Business stay mixed with holiday
reviews.text:
Very spacious suite, lovely pool and hot tub. Conference center had all the amenities expected of a 5 star hotel 

Stayed at the beginning of their‘Christmas at the Princess’ holiday extravaganza, complete with an amusement park, light show coreographed to music and a train ride!

reviews.author: liveandwork2travel
reviews.title: Bait and switch- terrible customer service
reviews.text:
This is our second time at the Fairmont Princess. Last year we stayed in the gold jr. suite. We liked the resort but didn’t like the location of that category of room. 
This year we booked a “deluxe” view room facing the lagoon. (Which ended up facing the children’s play ground, not the lagoon- which matters during Christmas)
The day before arrival I called the hotel to ask about getting my husband access to the spa gym (there are 2 gyms). I was told that we could buy a pass upon check in tomorrow. 
Upon check in the following day (after flying in from another state) we were told that they do not sell spa passes on Saturday and Sunday (we are here Friday-Monday). I explained that I had called the day before and was told we could buy them, the front desk male went and asked his manager who told him that the only way we could get the spa access for my husband was to upgrade to a different room at $500 EXTRA a night ($1500 for the stay) on top of the nearly $2000 we already paid for the deluxe room. 
No thanks. 
So we are told are room isn’t ready and to come back. Not a care given at my concern for being told two different things.  
After an hour and a half I get a text that our room is ready, so we come back to the front desk to get the keys.
We are met with a female and a trainee. 
We explain how that left a bad taste in our mouths as this was a “resort vacation” for us and had we known we wouldn’t be able to pay the $75 for the spa pass, we wouldn’t have come. 
They go back once again and speak to a manger, who says the same- upgrade at $500 a night or nothing. 

If we could leave, we would, but we can’t.
We usually go to the hotel del Coronado for a Christmas hotel weekend, but we liked this hotel so much, we came back- never again. 

This was my early birthday celebration- thanks for ruining it. 

Fairmont Princess- let me ask you this- is it worth losing customers over a $75 pass?!
 
Train your staff so everyone is on the same page.

Like another reviewer said- so many options- it’s a lot of money- go somewhere you and your money are appreciated.

reviews.author: Nick B
reviews.title: Kids? Convenience? 5 star hotel? THIS IS THE PLACE!
reviews.text:
What a phenomenal resort!

I recently visited here the week before Thanksgiving with my wife and son. Staff was awesome and we stayed in part of the resort that included breakfast and snacks throughout the day and night. Those were An amazing benefit. 

We paid a little more but the convenience factor along was worth it!

They had a really nice family pool which my son LOVED the waterside.  My son is autistic and he sometimes does not understand all the rules. With that being said when we told staff at the water slide they were EXTREMELY pleasant and understanding. I can’t even tell how many places where we have. Even that are the same caliber of this hotel that did not have this same attitude with my family. 

We did not know the resort decorated for Christmas but we got to see all the beautiful decorations and lights! We 200 percent will be back with our full
Family!

reviews.author: DMSinYYC
reviews.title: Absolutely MAGICAL!
reviews.text: I visited the Fairmont Princess in consideration of a conference booking.  The hotel was stunning. I was there just before Thanksgiving so I used the word magical as the resort was certainly bitten by the Holiday Spirit.  WOW.  I highly recommend a visit during this time.  We were able to view all the room types from Fairmont rooms to Gold to the Privado Villas.  ALL room categories were exceptional and newly renovated.  Very nice size as well.  The service was top notch...what you would expect from a 5 star resort. ....and the BEDS!!!  <3 <3 <3

reviews.author: kiwig14
reviews.title: Fun "winter" Christmas in the desert
reviews.text: Stayed at Privada the villas located on the property for Christmas at the Princess.   It is a huge event with over 7 million lights, a train, rides for kids and adults, tons of food options and different areas for adults and kids alike.   Not cheap but a fun "winter" experience in the desert.   Villas are wonderful for a family or couples as they each have a balcony/sitting area and separate facilities for guests.   Property has everything to offer including a great spa, restaurants, shops, adjacent golf - you name it they have it.

reviews.author: freeyourheel
reviews.title: Propane gas fires everywhere
reviews.text: Let me be clear, this is a nice hotel - as you would expect from a top chain. But I feel compelled to provide a negative review of our stay there with family in November 2024.  It was an unbelievable show of the excess of supposed luxury.  It was 70 and sunny and there were gas fires burning everywhere we went.  Once it got dark, it was like the whole place was on fire.  No, we did not have to stroll through the Christmas at princess village.  And yes, I could just ignore it.  But I think there are many travelers like me who would prefer not to see an ecological nightmare at their luxury hotel.  My thanks in advance to the hotel management for seriously taking on board this feedback.

reviews.author: bradq2905vq
reviews.title: Brad
reviews.text: It's the best place we have ever stayed the staff is great too us it's so beautiful there the landscape is gorgeous

reviews.author: Rachel F
reviews.title: Thanksgiving Treat
reviews.text: We had an amazing time here and the service was top notch! Our servers at Irownwood-  Zach I and Brandon were so friendly, kind, and professional. Madison and Anna at the Fairmont Gold lounge helped us with everything we needed and always with a smile. We hope to return back soon and enjoy another relaxing and rejuvenating trip!
